description: This Java source file defines a custom revision entity class for Hibernate Envers, used in the OpenMRS project. It extends DefaultRevisionEntity and adds custom fields to track who changed the entity and when.

classes.name: OpenmrsRevisionEntity
classes.description: A custom revision entity class for OpenMRS that extends Hibernate Envers' DefaultRevisionEntity to include additional metadata fields such as changedBy and changedOn.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Getter method for the changedBy field, returning the ID of the user who made the change.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Setter method for the changedBy field, setting the user ID who made the change.

methods.name: getChangedOn
methods.description: Getter method for the changedOn field, returning the date when the revision was made.

methods.name: setChangedOn
methods.description: Setter method for the changedOn field, setting the date when the revision was made.
